user_query: trass gmail with terms avask or gianfranco or australia and NOT mgm

intent.goal: search trass gmail messages containing 'avask', 'gianfranco', or 'australia', excluding 'mgm'

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%avask%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%avask%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%gianfranco%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%gianfranco%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%gianfranco%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%australia%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%australia%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%australia%'
)
AND g.subject NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND g.message_content NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND g.body_snippet NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 1200

sample_results.body_snippet: Dear Fionn, Thank you for the quick reply and for having John work on a solution. We recognize the extra effort that this has caused for your team and we thank you both for working with us to find a
sample_results.message_content: Dear Fionn, Thank you for the quick reply and for having John work on a solution. We recognize the extra effort that this has caused for your team and we thank you both for working with us to find a solution. Let's align on the past communication and next steps. Communication & Shared Learnings Looking back at the July emails, there was actually a communication gap on both sides. July 21st , you stated "we will advise you on the storage costs" if we were unable to access the shipbob UK FC “storage only”. July 29th , I confirmed ShipBob denied UK access, which triggered the path in which we indeed needed to utilize one of Alina's facilities. July 30th , I confirmed we'd need storage for "less than a month" (our best estimate at the time) July 31st , you provided us with an update that you “coordinated with Alina regarding this issue, and she [could] assist in arranging temporary storage in the UK”. And you asked us to “provide an estimated duration" This is where the communication breakdown occurred. I failed to follow up with the dates and I apologize for that. I’m taking note of this moving forward. However, this is a significant piece of the logistics puzzle, especially considering the pricing. As with our other communications, when something goes unaddressed we’ve both been diligent about not letting the thread drop. We gave no explicit indication that we did not want to move forward with arranging storage with Alina. This is something that should not fall through the cracks due to one missed email. We're talking about a significant charge that was foreseeable, especially since we can only provide estimates for registration timelines based on what our tax agents tell us. In summary, this is a mutual learning opportunity for clearer communication going forward. VAT/EORI Timeline Our latest estimate from our uk agent AVASK is that we should receive the confirmation letter by the "end of October." There is no firm date, and it is coming via physical mail, so we cannot guarantee it will arrive by October 24. Our best guess is that we will be set to move the goods to ShipBob’s facility in the first week of November. Next Steps Please confirm: Once goods clear customs between Oct 5-8, is the plan to transport them directly to the new, more affordable facility John is sourcing? We want to ensure we can bypass the current expensive warehouse entirely. We look forward to the update on the alternative warehouse tomorrow. Best, Koii Koii Benvenutto PM Plush and Merch koii@trassgames.com

sample_results.message_content: Dear Fionn, Thank you for your prompt reply. Let's work together and align on a solution. Our access to the ShipBob location is currently blocked due to the lagging UK tax registration process so storing the goods at the ShipBob location is not an option at this time. The £572/day storage rate is unworkable for us. This translates to over $23,000 USD over the next month—a cost we did not anticipate and cannot absorb. When we agreed to temporary storage, our only reference was the ~$19 AUD/day rate in Australia. We view this as a partnership, and we understand you have operational costs to cover. However, moving forward, we need transparency on the possibility of significant costs like this one, especially when they are this far outside the benchmark. Let's solve this together. As a starting point: Is there a fair one-time rate you can offer us that covers your essential costs while we arrange to move the goods ASAP? We trust your expertise. Please recommend a more suitable, cost-effective storage facility to which we can transfer the inventory. This is a learning opportunity for our team especially on international logistics. We will ensure our planning is tighter in the future. I can give you my word on that. And we ask for more proactive communication on any potential high-cost scenarios from your side. I look forward to your prompt reply. Best, Koii Koii Benvenutto PM Plush and Merch koii@trassgames.com
